cases.setup_script:
set -e
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.com GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.com
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2020-01-01T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2020-01-01T00:00:00Z'
cat > fakessh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# fixture-only stand-in for ssh: drop option pairs, run the far command locally
while [ $# -gt 2 ]; do case $1 in -o|-p) shift 2;; *) shift;; esac; done
exec /bin/sh -c "PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/lib/git-core; $2"
EOF
chmod 755 fakessh
G=/usr/bin/git
$G init -q -b main src
cd src
printf 'one\n' > a.txt; mkdir dir; printf 'bee\n' > dir/b.txt; $G add .; $G commit -q -m c1
printf 'two\n' > a.txt; $G commit -q -am c2
printf 'three\n' > a.txt; $G commit -q -am c3
cd ..
$G clone -q --bare src server.git
$G --git-dir=server.git config http.receivepack true
cases.script:
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.com GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.com
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2020-02-01T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2020-02-01T00:00:00Z'
export GIT_SSH_COMMAND=/tmp/parity-case/fakessh
SG="/usr/bin/git --git-dir=/tmp/parity-case/server.git"
U=ssh://fixture/tmp/parity-case/server.git
yn() { if "$@"; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; }
has() { case $1 in *"$2"*) echo yes;; *) echo no;; esac; }
cleanup() { cd /tmp/parity-case; /bin/rm -rf src server.git cl cl2 hcl miss; }
git clone -q $U cl 2>"$HOME/err.txt"; echo "clone-rc=$?"
cd cl
echo "head-matches-server=$(yn [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$($SG rev-parse refs/heads/main)" ])"
echo "tracking-ref-matches-server=$(yn [ "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)" = "$($SG rev-parse refs/heads/main)" ])"
echo "branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)"
echo "commits=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)"
echo "a.txt=$(<a.txt) b.txt=$(<dir/b.txt)"
cleanup
cases.stdout:
clone-rc=0
head-matches-server=yes
tracking-ref-matches-server=yes
branch=main
commits=3
a.txt=three b.txt=bee
cases.oracle: System git 2.47.3 (Debian trixie) run by the reference shell as the reference client; the server side is always the independent system git (git-upload-pack, git-receive-pack, git-http-backend) over a fixture-only fake ssh command or a loopback CGI peer; refs, counts and file bytes are also read back from the server repository with the system git
cases.comparison: r1: cloning ssh://fixture/PATH through the fake-ssh pipe transport (upload-pack) checks out main with the server's 3 commits, tracking ref and file bytes equal to the server repository The clone, server and source repositories are removed after the read-backs, because their internal pack/loose layout is not part of the requirement and would otherwise dominate the tree comparison.
